build_CrissCrossAttention_module: build a CrissCrossAttention module with a given number of input channels for feature map processing
run_CrissCrossAttention_forward: run the forward pass of CrissCrossAttention on a 4D input tensor with shape batch channels height width
create_NEG_INF_DIAG_matrix: create a negative infinity diagonal matrix of size n by n on a specified device
review_CrissCrossAttention_init: review the CrissCrossAttention constructor that initializes query key and value convolution layers with gamma scaling
test_CrissCrossAttention_forward_pass: test the CrissCrossAttention forward method by passing a batch of feature maps and verifying output shape
